messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action in the source video to the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then raises both arms overhead in a stretching or dancing motion before lowering them back to her sides.","camera":"Static full-body shot from a slightly low angle, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"She wears a patterned grey and white sleeveless crop top, high-waisted teal wide-leg pants, a dark choker, and dark sandals with red straps.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short blue bob with straight bangs and a small low ponytail at the back.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, dark skin, and a short bob haircut.","scene":"An outdoor industrial area with cracked concrete ground, a pile of wooden pallets to the left, and rusty pipes and stone structures in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character now stands in place and performs an arm-raising dance/stretch sequence similar to the reference, then returns to a standing pose. Her blue hair, patterned crop top, teal pants, sandals, and the outdoor industrial scene remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source character's walking action with the dance/stretch motion shown in the reference, while preserving the source character's identity, clothing, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the output motion matches the reference timing and pose details exactly.
unexpected_changes: The source character's walking motion was removed and replaced with a stationary dance motion.
